findings.claim: Across the observed score window [0.0,0.49], the eight read landmark-0/1 displacement and soft-mass curves are non-monotone: every one shows 4-10 sign changes and 1-10 strong sign conflicts, and no polynomial fit is accepted (polynomial_accepted=false for all eight).

Whole-window means are small relative to the within-window excursions: landmark_00_local_dx whole_window_z=-0.184, landmark_00_local_dy=-0.301, landmark_00_local_dz=-0.024, landmark_01_local_dx=-0.218, landmark_01_local_dy=-0.499, landmark_01_local_dz=-0.013, landmark_01_soft_mass=-0.248, while landmark_00_soft_mass is the only one with a positive whole-window mean (+0.639).

Endpoint rate contrasts are large and opposite in sign for several features: landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z=-17.49 vs last_rate_z=+8.11; landmark_00_local_dy -72.37 vs +5.52; landmark_00_soft_mass +9.27 vs -10.00; landmark_01_local_dx +22.31 vs -12.17; landmark_01_local_dy -42.82 vs +5.00; landmark_01_local_dz -58.49 vs +8.83; landmark_01_soft_mass -25.98 vs +0.89. These are rate contrasts, not absolute coordinate targets.

landmark_00_soft_mass is the only read feature with a coherent mid-window rise and late decline (values_z rising to ~1.64 near t=0.16 and falling to ~-0.28 at t=0.49) and the lowest relative_node_RMSE (0.286) among the eight read curves, but it still has 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict.

hypotheses.direction: early-window increase, late-window return toward baseline
hypotheses.falsifier: If the compiled schedule does not change the realized landmark_00_soft_mass trace relative to M2, or if the late-window decline is not reproduced, the hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass (predicted endpoint world-A soft mass proxy)
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_soft_mass coordinate shows a mid-window elevation followed by late-window relaxation over the observed support; a reward schedule that increases curvature (larger delta) early and returns toward baseline curvature late would test whether this temporal contrast is exploitable, without asserting an absolute target value.

hypotheses.direction: early-window larger curvature, late-window smaller curvature
hypotheses.falsifier: If the realized landmark_00_local_dx/dy traces are unchanged from M2 under the compiled schedule, or if the sign of the endpoint rate contrast does not flip, the hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dy (predicted endpoint world-A displacement)
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dy displacement coordinates show opposite-sign endpoint rate contrasts (early negative, late positive) with small whole-window means, indicating a transient rather than a stationary offset; a schedule that applies larger curvature early and smaller curvature late would test whether this transient contrast is controllable.

hypotheses.direction: early-window larger curvature, late-window smaller curvature
hypotheses.falsifier: If the realized landmark_01_local_dz trace is unchanged from M2 under the compiled schedule, or if the endpoint rate contrast does not change sign, the hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_01_local_dz coordinate shows a strong early negative rate contrast and a late positive rate contrast with a near-zero whole-window mean, consistent with a transient excursion; a schedule with larger curvature early and smaller curvature late would test whether this transient is controllable.

limitations: Only landmark_00 and landmark_01 displacement and soft-mass curves were read; the remaining 192 catalogue features (including all local_cxx/cxy/cxz/cyy/cyz/czz components and landmarks 02-19) are unqueried, so no claim is made about them.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; all statements are restricted to the continuous curves over the observed support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false.
Selection preference and curve contrasts are associations, not measured descendant survival or final decoded affinity benefit; no current outcome data were supplied to this role.
The curves are untyped coordinate proxies; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
Endpoint rate contrasts (first_rate_z, last_rate_z) are time derivatives of the observed feature, not spatial reward gradients and not absolute coordinate targets.
